## Summary

Describe the behavior, the reason for the change, and its user or developer impact.

## Risk

Mark affected boundaries and explain the mitigation below.

- [ ] Permissions or security
- [ ] Configuration, persistence, or migration
- [ ] Provider or remote compute
- [ ] Coordinator routing or model profiles
- [ ] Terminal UI or accessibility
- [ ] Packaging or release behavior
- [ ] No material boundary change

- [ ] Source compiles
- [ ] Ruff lint and format checks pass
- [ ] Tests pass

- [ ] Documentation updated for public behavior
